s0001.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day the moon encroached upon Mao.
s0001.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day the moon encroached upon Mao.

s0002.literal: On jiachen day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0002.idiomatic: On jiachen day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0003.literal: On bingwu day regulations were fixed for counterfeiting and re-issuing paper money offenses: ringleaders were to receive one hundred seven blows of the staff, followers two grades lighter;
s0003.idiomatic: On bingwu day regulations were fixed for counterfeiting and re-issuing paper money offenses: ringleaders were to receive 107 blows of the staff, followers two grades lighter;

s0004.literal: On a second offense, followers received the same staff penalty as ringleaders, and ringleaders were banished.
s0004.idiomatic: On a second offense, followers received the same staff penalty as ringleaders, and ringleaders were banished.

s0005.literal: On jiyou day, because the harvest failed, wine-brewing was forbidden in prefectures of Hebei, Gansu, Shaanxi, and elsewhere.
s0005.idiomatic: On jiyou day, because the harvest failed, wine-brewing was forbidden in prefectures of Hebei, Gansu, Shaanxi, and elsewhere.

s0006.literal: On pasture land in Yidu and other places that commoners had reclaimed, the rent of one dou per mu was deemed too heavy and reduced to four sheng.
s0006.idiomatic: On pasture land in Yidu and other places that commoners had reclaimed, the rent of one dou per mu was deemed too heavy and reduced to four sheng.

s0007.literal: Prohibitions on mountains, marshes, rivers, and lakes in famine-stricken areas were lifted for one year; eight thousand shi of grain were distributed in relief to impoverished households of Nai.
s0007.idiomatic: Prohibitions on mountains, marshes, rivers, and lakes in famine-stricken areas were lifted for one year; 8,000 shi of grain were distributed in relief to impoverished households of Nai.

s0008.literal: On renzi day the field survey at Guide Prefecture was abolished.
s0008.idiomatic: On renzi day the field survey at Guide Prefecture was abolished.

s0009.literal: On yimao day an edict declared: for all anonymous letters, those whose language was grave were to be executed, lighter ones banished and assigned; the first informant was granted notes in graded amounts, and their wives and children were all registered and confiscated to make up the reward.
s0009.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict declared: for all anonymous letters, those whose language was grave were to be executed, lighter ones banished and assigned; the first informant was granted notes in graded amounts, and their wives and children were all registered and confiscated to make up the reward.

s0010.literal: The censorate and the imperial clan court were ordered to appoint officials to dispatch Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's wives and children to the capital; their family property was still to be sealed and registered, and their weapons, sea vessels, and the like seized.
s0010.idiomatic: The censorate and the imperial clan court were ordered to appoint officials to dispatch Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's wives and children to the capital; their family property was still to be sealed and registered, and their weapons, sea vessels, and the like seized.

s0011.literal: On dingsi day the privy council was ordered to select ten soldiers skilled in agriculture to instruct frontline garrison-farming troops.
s0011.idiomatic: On dingsi day the privy council was ordered to select 10 soldiers skilled in agriculture to instruct frontline garrison-farming troops.

s0012.literal: Yeti Hu'erde was granted fifty taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, one thousand ingots of notes, and one hundred bolts of silks and cloths.
s0012.idiomatic: Yeti Hu'erde was granted 50 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 1,000 ingots of notes, and 100 bolts of silks and cloths.

s0013.literal: Second month, on renxu day an edict ordered the central secretariat to cut redundant staff in all agencies, and also instructed the privy council that except for generals on campaign, those administering council affairs were to have their numbers fixed and reported.
s0013.idiomatic: Second month, on renxu day an edict ordered the central secretariat to cut redundant staff in all agencies, and also instructed the privy council that except for generals on campaign, those administering council affairs were to have their numbers fixed and reported.

s0014.literal: On xinwei day Mubarak Shah, grand councillor and acting Shangdu resident, and Alawadin, grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat; Shang Wen, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan regional censorate, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Dong Shizhen, associate administrator of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0014.idiomatic: On xinwei day Mubarak Shah, grand councillor and acting Shangdu resident, and Alawadin, grand councillor of the Shaanxi branch secretariat, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat; Shang Wen, censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan regional censorate, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Dong Shizhen, associate administrator of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0015.literal: On renshen day an edict declared: "The privy council, imperial clan court, and the like — from now on on every matter they are to deliberate jointly with the central secretariat before memorializing the throne;
s0015.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict declared, "The privy council, imperial clan court, and the like — from now on on every matter they are to deliberate jointly with the central secretariat before memorializing the throne;

s0016.literal: No agency may on its own memorialize on transfers and appointments; even where officials have been appointed by special imperial order, if precedent is not satisfied, a renewed memorial is likewise permitted."
s0016.idiomatic: No agency may on its own memorialize on transfers and appointments; even where officials have been appointed by special imperial order, if precedent is not satisfied, a renewed memorial is likewise permitted."

s0017.literal: On jiaxu day redundant staff of the Hangzhou tax superintendency were reduced.
s0017.idiomatic: On jiaxu day redundant staff of the Hangzhou tax superintendency were reduced.

s0018.literal: On bingzi day an edict declared that Karakorum troops were to rotate garrison every six years, and notes were still to be issued to supply their want.
s0018.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict declared that Karakorum troops were to rotate garrison every six years, and notes were still to be issued to supply their want.

s0019.literal: Troops of the Western Capital under Yesidiyer and troops raised at Dadu were all ordered to reach Shangdu in fourth month and proceed north in fifth month.
s0019.idiomatic: Troops of the Western Capital under Yesidiyer and troops raised at Dadu were all ordered to reach Shangdu in fourth month and proceed north in fifth month.

s0020.literal: On dingchou day princes were ordered that Prince Chubo, when not on urgent business, was not to travel by relay.
s0020.idiomatic: On dingchou day princes were ordered that Prince Chubo, when not on urgent business, was not to travel by relay.

s0021.literal: An edict fixed the central secretariat establishment from the left and right chancellors downward: two grand councillors, one left and one right vice chancellor each, two associate administrators — fixed at eight chief officials.
s0021.idiomatic: An edict fixed the central secretariat establishment from the left and right chancellors downward: two grand councillors, one left and one right vice chancellor each, two associate administrators — fixed at eight chief officials.

s0022.literal: On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Heart.
s0022.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0023.literal: On jimao day all corvée levies in inner circuits where famine had struck were entirely remitted; Henan Province was still ordered to relieve and succor displaced persons, and three hundred eighty thousand ingots of notes were granted to northern army troops.
s0023.idiomatic: On jimao day all corvée levies in inner circuits where famine had struck were entirely remitted; Henan Province was still ordered to relieve and succor displaced persons, and 380,000 ingots of notes were granted to northern army troops.

s0024.literal: Because Chen Yiji of Annam had long resided at Ezhou, one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0024.idiomatic: Because Chen Yiji of Annam had long resided at Ezhou, 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0025.literal: Surveillance censor Duotai was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0025.idiomatic: Surveillance censor Duotai was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0026.literal: Censorate officials said: "Ali, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, left vice chancellor Gao Zhu and An You, and provincial commissioner Zhang You and others bought fifteen thousand salt certificates under false names and resold them at increased price — we ask that provincial and censorate officials be dispatched to investigate."
s0026.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Ali, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, left vice chancellor Gao Zhu and An You, and provincial commissioner Zhang You and others bought 15,000 salt certificates under false names and resold them at increased price — we ask that provincial and censorate officials be dispatched to investigate."

s0028.literal: Taiyuan, Datong, and Pingluan Route suffered famine; grain was sold at reduced price in relief.
s0028.idiomatic: Taiyuan, Datong, and Pingluan Route suffered famine; grain was sold at reduced price in relief.

s0029.literal: On gengchen day the Shaanxi and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to relieve impoverished households in Fengxiang, Qin, Gong, Ganzhou, and Hemili.
s0029.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Shaanxi and Gansu branch secretariats were ordered to relieve impoverished households in Fengxiang, Qin, Gong, Ganzhou, and Hemili.

s0030.literal: Surveillance censors Du Kengou and others reported that Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Wanze had accepted bribes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; no response.
s0030.idiomatic: Surveillance censors Du Kengou and others reported that Grand Preceptor and Right Chancellor Wanze had accepted bribes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; no response.

s0031.literal: On renwu day the Emperor addressed central secretariat officials, saying: "Recently there have been those who, because yearly tax revenues increased as surplus, hoped to seek enfeoffment and rewards — if this is not exacting from the people, whence does it come?
s0031.idiomatic: On renwu day the Emperor addressed central secretariat officials, saying, "Recently there have been those who, because yearly tax revenues increased as surplus, hoped to seek enfeoffment and rewards — if this is not exacting from the people, whence does it come?

s0032.literal: From now on apart from the original quotas, do not treat surplus increases as regular figures."
s0032.idiomatic: From now on apart from the original quotas, do not treat surplus increases as regular figures."

s0033.literal: The Jiangnan Finance Chief Commission and its superintendencies were abolished.
s0033.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Finance Chief Commission and its superintendencies were abolished.

s0034.literal: Officials of the inner and outer central secretariat and the Ministry of Revenue transport commissions were forbidden to buy salt certificates privately.
s0034.idiomatic: Officials of the inner and outer central secretariat and the Ministry of Revenue transport commissions were forbidden to buy salt certificates privately.

s0036.literal: All persons were forbidden to take gold, silver, silk thread, and the like abroad.
s0036.idiomatic: All persons were forbidden to take gold, silver, silk thread, and the like abroad.

s0037.literal: The Jiangnan Chief Water and Corvée Fields Office and the Mobile Bureau of Transmission were abolished.
s0037.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Chief Water and Corvée Fields Office and the Mobile Bureau of Transmission were abolished.

s0038.literal: The Dadu Salt Transport Commission was merged into the Hejian Transport Commission; the capital wine tax revenues it administered were placed under the Ministry of Revenue.
s0038.idiomatic: The Dadu Salt Transport Commission was merged into the Hejian Transport Commission; the capital wine tax revenues it administered were placed under the Ministry of Revenue.

s0039.literal: All persons were forbidden to present precious goods as tribute without receiving an imperial order.
s0039.idiomatic: All persons were forbidden to present precious goods as tribute without receiving an imperial order.

s0040.literal: Redundant persons of all categories who falsely claimed keshik status and princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and consorts' household dependents who improperly requested money and grain were cut.
s0040.idiomatic: Redundant persons of all categories who falsely claimed keshik status and princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and consorts' household dependents who improperly requested money and grain were cut.

s0041.literal: Zhending Route suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of notes were distributed in relief.
s0041.idiomatic: Zhending Route suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of notes were distributed in relief.

s0042.literal: Princes Xiao Xie and falconers and the like were still instructed not to hunt near Zhending and harass the people.
s0042.idiomatic: Princes Xiao Xie and falconers and the like were still instructed not to hunt near Zhending and harass the people.

s0043.literal: On bingxu day an edict declared that apart from frontier campaign soldiers and relay households of the two capitals, all other households were equally to bear corvée service.
s0043.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict declared that apart from frontier campaign soldiers and relay households of the two capitals, all other households were equally to bear corvée service.

s0044.literal: On dinghai day an edict declared that from now on, apart from the privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau continuing to memorialize on selection as before, no agency might memorialize on its own; all persons recommended for appointment were to pass through the central secretariat.
s0044.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict declared that from now on, apart from the privy council, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau continuing to memorialize on selection as before, no agency might memorialize on its own; all persons recommended for appointment were to pass through the central secretariat.

s0045.literal: Third month, on jichou new moon day Baoding Route suffered famine; forty thousand ingots of notes were distributed in relief.
s0045.idiomatic: Third month, on jichou new moon day Baoding Route suffered famine; 40,000 ingots of notes were distributed in relief.

s0046.literal: On gengyin day an edict dispatched pacification envoys to tour the circuits: Hao Tianbing and Tacu to Jiangnan and Jiangbei, Shi Gui to Yannan and Shandong, Yelü Xiyi and Liu Geng to Hedong and Shaanxi, Tielituohuan and Rong Yi to Liang-Zhe and Jiangdong, Zhao Rongrong and Yue Shumo to Jiangnan and Huguang, Mubarak and Chen Ying to Jiangxi and Fujian, Tachihaiya and Liu Minzhong to Shanbei and Liaodong — all were granted rank-two silver seals, and edicts of admonition were also issued to them.
s0046.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict dispatched pacification envoys to tour the circuits: Hao Tianbing and Tacu to Jiangnan and Jiangbei, Shi Gui to Yannan and Shandong, Yelü Xiyi and Liu Geng to Hedong and Shaanxi, Tielituohuan and Rong Yi to Liang-Zhe and Jiangdong, Zhao Rongrong and Yue Shumo to Jiangnan and Huguang, Mubarak and Chen Ying to Jiangxi and Fujian, Tachihaiya and Liu Minzhong to Shanbei and Liaodong — all were granted rank-2 silver seals, and edicts of admonition were also issued to them.

s0047.literal: Toghto, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, dispatched Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's families; their households bribed him heavily with gold and pearls; Toghto reported this.
s0047.idiomatic: Toghto, grand councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, dispatched Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's families; their households bribed him heavily with gold and pearls; Toghto reported this.

s0048.literal: The Emperor instructed him, saying: "We entrusted Jiangnan to you — you have indeed done thus; this is truly a man's deed.
s0048.idiomatic: The Emperor instructed him, saying, "We entrusted Jiangnan to you — you have indeed done thus; this is truly a man's deed.

s0049.literal: Be all the more conscientious in your duties."
s0049.idiomatic: Be all the more conscientious in your duties."

s0050.literal: He was granted fifty taels of gold.
s0050.idiomatic: He was granted 50 taels of gold.

s0051.literal: Fire broke out in the capital; the central secretariat and privy council were ordered to deliberate on increasing patrol troops.
s0051.idiomatic: Fire broke out in the capital; the central secretariat and privy council were ordered to deliberate on increasing patrol troops.

s0052.literal: The Gansu branch secretariat's supply of army funds and grain had many abuses; an edict moved the surveillance commission to Ganzhou.
s0052.idiomatic: The Gansu branch secretariat's supply of army funds and grain had many abuses; an edict moved the surveillance commission to Ganzhou.

s0053.literal: On renchen day penalties for adultery, theft, and the like in the Dadu north and south horse-and-troop offices were fixed: those age sixty-seven and below were turned over to their route, those age seventy-seven and above to the yeke jarquchi.
s0053.idiomatic: On renchen day penalties for adultery, theft, and the like in the Dadu north and south horse-and-troop offices were fixed: those age 67 and below were turned over to their route, those age 77 and above to the yeke jarquchi.

s0054.literal: Hejian Route's grain crop failed; construction labor on Buddhist temples was ordered stopped.
s0054.idiomatic: Hejian Route's grain crop failed; construction labor on Buddhist temples was ordered stopped.

s0055.literal: On yiwei day Zhending Route suffered famine; more than six hundred sixty ingots of notes were distributed in relief.
s0055.idiomatic: On yiwei day Zhending Route suffered famine; more than 660 ingots of notes were distributed in relief.

s0056.literal: Grand councillors Bayan, Liang Degui, Duan Zhen, and Ali Hun Sali, right vice chancellor Badmashin, left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua, and associate administrators Merhuozhe and Zhang Silin and others had accepted bribes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; punishment was graded accordingly — an edict dismissed them all.
s0056.idiomatic: Grand councillors Bayan, Liang Degui, Duan Zhen, and Ali Hun Sali, right vice chancellor Badmashin, left vice chancellor Yuegu Buhua, and associate administrators Merhuozhe and Zhang Silin and others had accepted bribes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; punishment was graded accordingly — an edict dismissed them all.

s0057.literal: Hong Junxiang was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; a surveillance censor said he had formerly served in the privy council and had been dismissed for bribery, and requested another able man be selected instead — no response.
s0057.idiomatic: Hong Junxiang was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; a surveillance censor said he had formerly served in the privy council and had been dismissed for bribery, and requested another able man be selected instead — no response.

s0058.literal: On jiachen day an edict fixed bribery offenses in twelve chapters.
s0058.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict fixed bribery offenses in 12 chapters.

s0059.literal: Capital officials, apart from monthly salary, were additionally granted salary rice;
s0059.idiomatic: Capital officials, apart from monthly salary, were additionally granted salary rice;

s0060.literal: Local officials without public fields were also granted rice in measured amounts.
s0060.idiomatic: Local officials without public fields were also granted rice in measured amounts.

s0061.literal: On yisi day, because the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives ended in defeat, Liu Shen was executed, Heladai and Zheng You were flogged, and the Yunnan Burma campaign provincial government was abolished.
s0061.idiomatic: On yisi day, because the campaign against the Eight Hundred Wives ended in defeat, Liu Shen was executed, Heladai and Zheng You were flogged, and the Yunnan Burma campaign provincial government was abolished.

s0062.literal: On wushen day Xiaolanxi, Yue Xuan, and others presented the 《Unified Gazetteer of Great Unity》; rewards were granted in graded amounts.
s0062.idiomatic: On wushen day Xiaolanxi, Yue Xuan, and others presented the 《Unified Gazetteer of Great Unity》; rewards were granted in graded amounts.

s0063.literal: On jiyou day imperial letters reducing or exempting corvée purchase and market purchase were recalled.
s0063.idiomatic: On jiyou day imperial letters reducing or exempting corvée purchase and market purchase were recalled.

s0064.literal: Because Tuohuan falsely accused Prince Toghto, he was demoted and placed with the Huguang branch secretariat army to redeem himself.
s0064.idiomatic: Because Tuohuan falsely accused Prince Toghto, he was demoted and placed with the Huguang branch secretariat army to redeem himself.

s0065.literal: Gansu branch secretariat mobilization of militia and investigation counts of relay households' dependents and livestock were abolished.
s0065.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat mobilization of militia and investigation counts of relay households' dependents and livestock were abolished.

s0066.literal: On gengxu day Ayiqaha households collected by Tiegecha'er were restored to Prince Toghto's jurisdiction.
s0066.idiomatic: On gengxu day Ayiqaha households collected by Tiegecha'er were restored to Prince Toghto's jurisdiction.

s0067.literal: On guichou day privy council officials and a surveillance censor said: "Censor-in-chief Dong Shixuan borrowed notes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan — improper."
s0067.idiomatic: On guichou day privy council officials and a surveillance censor said, "Censor-in-chief Dong Shixuan borrowed notes from Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan — improper."

s0068.literal: The Emperor said: "Need not inquire into censorate members' lending; if the speakers do not cease, later they shall be beaten."
s0068.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Need not inquire into censorate members' lending; if the speakers do not cease, later they shall be beaten."

s0069.literal: On jiayin day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
s0069.idiomatic: On jiayin day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.

s0070.literal: On bingchen day Prince Xiao Xie's households and others were granted sixty thousand ingots of notes; relay households of Liling Terrace and four other stations were relieved with more than fourteen hundred ingots.
s0070.idiomatic: On bingchen day Prince Xiao Xie's households and others were granted 60,000 ingots of notes; relay households of Liling Terrace and four other stations were relieved with more than 1,400 ingots.

s0071.literal: Liaoyang and other routes suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of notes were distributed in relief.
s0071.idiomatic: Liaoyang and other routes suffered famine; 10,000 ingots of notes were distributed in relief.

s0072.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guihai day the moon encroached upon Eastern Well.
s0072.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai day the moon encroached upon Eastern Well.

s0073.literal: An edict to the branch secretariat, censorate, privy council, and Bureau of Transmission declared: whenever summoning Dadu chief administrator's office officials, sealed summons must be used; other agencies may not summon them at will.
s0073.idiomatic: An edict to the branch secretariat, censorate, privy council, and Bureau of Transmission declared: whenever summoning Dadu chief administrator's office officials, sealed summons must be used; other agencies may not summon them at will.

s0074.literal: Chen Tianxiang, Zhang Konsun, and Guo Jun — frontier subjects summoned to court — Chen Tianxiang and Zhang Konsun were made grand academicians of the Jixian Hall, and Guo Jun was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; all deliberated central secretariat affairs jointly.
s0074.idiomatic: Chen Tianxiang, Zhang Konsun, and Guo Jun — frontier subjects summoned to court — Chen Tianxiang and Zhang Konsun were made grand academicians of the Jixian Hall, and Guo Jun was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; all deliberated central secretariat affairs jointly.

s0075.literal: On bingyin day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
s0075.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

s0076.literal: On gengwu day, because central secretariat documents were excessively numerous, for rank-two agencies that should submit to the secretariat, they were ordered to deal only with the Six Ministries.
s0076.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because central secretariat documents were excessively numerous, for rank-2 agencies that should submit to the secretariat, they were ordered to deal only with the Six Ministries.

s0077.literal: Left Chancellor Darqan said: "When monks complete Buddhist rites, they invariably release serious criminals.
s0077.idiomatic: Left Chancellor Darqan said, "When monks complete Buddhist rites, they invariably release serious criminals.

s0078.literal: Murderers and wives or concubines who killed their husbands — all are released by name.
s0078.idiomatic: Murderers and wives or concubines who killed their husbands — all are released by name.

s0079.literal: The living escape punishment while the dead bear injustice — what merit is there in this?"
s0079.idiomatic: The living escape punishment while the dead bear injustice — what merit is there in this?"

s0080.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted this.
s0080.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and accepted this.

s0081.literal: On xinwei day Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's descendants were banished to distant regions; travel expenses were still provided.
s0081.idiomatic: On xinwei day Zhu Qing's and Zhang Xuan's descendants were banished to distant regions; travel expenses were still provided.

s0082.literal: On yihai day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0082.idiomatic: On yihai day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0083.literal: On gengchen day Shejie submitted; Haiersun was ordered to command five thousand troops to garrison the place; the remaining forces were all sent back to their garrisons.
s0083.idiomatic: On gengchen day Shejie submitted; Haiersun was ordered to command 5,000 troops to garrison the place; the remaining forces were all sent back to their garrisons.

s0084.literal: One thousand Sichuan soldiers from Diaomen were transferred to garrison Luoluo Si; local troops engaged in road repair were all released and sent home.
s0084.idiomatic: 1,000 Sichuan soldiers from Diaomen were transferred to garrison Luoluo Si; local troops engaged in road repair were all released and sent home.

s0085.literal: On jiashen day Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0085.idiomatic: On jiashen day Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0086.literal: On dinghai day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost.
s0086.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jupiter encroached upon Ghost.

s0088.literal: Weihui Route and Chen Prefecture suffered armyworm; Jinan Route — falling frost killed wheat.
s0088.idiomatic: Weihui Route and Chen Prefecture suffered armyworm; Jinan Route — falling frost killed wheat.

s0089.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day Karakorum troops were granted three hundred eighty thousand ingots of notes.
s0089.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jichou day Karakorum troops were granted 380,000 ingots of notes.

s0090.literal: The wine prohibition at Shangdu and Dadu was lifted; counties and prefectures under the two capitals and Shanhou, Hedong, Shanxi, and Henan — those that had reported famine — still had the prohibition fully maintained.
s0090.idiomatic: The wine prohibition at Shangdu and Dadu was lifted; counties and prefectures under the two capitals and Shanhou, Hedong, Shanxi, and Henan — those that had reported famine — still had the prohibition fully maintained.

s0091.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to rectify finances and grain.
s0091.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to rectify finances and grain.

s0092.literal: On renchen day Mercury encroached upon Eastern Well.
s0092.idiomatic: On renchen day Mercury encroached upon Eastern Well.

s0093.literal: For battle merit in the fifth year of Dade, northern army troops were rewarded with two hundred thousand taels of silver, two hundred thousand ingots of notes, and fifty-nine thousand bolts each of silks and cloths.
s0093.idiomatic: For battle merit in the fifth year of Dade, northern army troops were rewarded with 200,000 taels of silver, 200,000 ingots of notes, and 59,000 bolts each of silks and cloths.

s0094.literal: Imperial nephew Khayishan and Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Toghto and Babusha, and imperial son-in-law Manzitai were each granted fifty taels of gold and graded amounts of silver, pearls, brocade, silks, and the like.
s0094.idiomatic: Imperial nephew Khayishan and Prince of Anxi Ananda, princes Toghto and Babusha, and imperial son-in-law Manzitai were each granted 50 taels of gold and graded amounts of silver, pearls, brocade, silks, and the like.

s0095.literal: On bingshen day fourteen thousand returned troops from the Burma campaign were sent back to their garrisons.
s0095.idiomatic: On bingshen day 14,000 returned troops from the Burma campaign were sent back to their garrisons.

s0096.literal: On guimao day an edict declared: for Karakorum army grain, apart from the annual disbursement of one hundred twenty thousand shi, the remainder might not be drawn without imperial order.
s0096.idiomatic: On guimao day an edict declared: for Karakorum army grain, apart from the annual disbursement of 120,000 shi, the remainder might not be drawn without imperial order.

s0097.literal: On dingwei day Chagha'er came to court; for battle merit he was granted fifty taels of gold and four hundred taels of silver, and more than six hundred ninety thousand ingots were still granted to impoverished soldiers under his ten-thousand-household command.
s0097.idiomatic: On dingwei day Chagha'er came to court; for battle merit he was granted 50 taels of gold and 400 taels of silver, and more than 690,000 ingots were still granted to impoverished soldiers under his ten-thousand-household command.

s0098.literal: On xinhai day pacification envoys Yelü Xiyi and Liu Geng said: "The Pingyang monk Chaoliwei has committed more than one offense; officials fear his power and dare not investigate; hearing of our arrival, he fled secretly to the capital.
s0098.idiomatic: On xinhai day pacification envoys Yelü Xiyi and Liu Geng said, "The Pingyang monk Chaoliwei has committed more than one offense; officials fear his power and dare not investigate; hearing of our arrival, he fled secretly to the capital.

s0099.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "He should be captured and sent back to his locality; let the branch secretariat, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau dispatch officials for joint trial."
s0099.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "He should be captured and sent back to his locality; let the branch secretariat, censorate, and Xuanzheng Bureau dispatch officials for joint trial."
